note: Main Campground strung along Campground Road on a wooded ridge north of the visitor center; the park's map warns that its access road has a steep grade. WiFi reaches sites 1-13. The separate Spring Creek primitive campground (21 sites, no hookups) sits on the Spring Creek embayment of the Tennessee River. --Claude
summary: TN State Parks Main Campground confirmed: 25 sites, all water+electric (50 A at 6-24, sewer only at 14), max 90 ft, one pull-through; $27-54 (stored $27-51; holiday weekends now read); year-round; showers, laundry, dump, wifi. Not waterfront kept. Pin ~600 m off (Scout Camp) -> 35.6636,-88.0054. Phone empty -> 731-847-0841. Access-road steep-grade warning put in the note.
flags: PIN: stored 35.66861,-88.00835 sits at the Scout Camp clearing by the Parrish Branch inlet (park map: Scout Camp ~1.45 km north of the visitor center at 35.65571,-88.00682). The Main Campground's pads line Campground Rd at ~35.6636,-88.0054 (Esri linear clearing matching the campground map), ~600 m SSE. Move the pin there.
PHONE: none stored -> 731-847-0841 (Park Office, camping page and campground map).

ACCESS: the park's own campground map says 'WARNING Main Campground access road has steep grade'. No 4WD/RV-not-recommended wording; the campground has 50-ft concrete pads and a 90-ft pull-through, so kept with a warning in the note (not a drop candidate).
SITES: the camping page says hookups at '19 of the 25 campsites'; the reservation engine and the campground map show water + electric at all 25 (the stored note's '4 primitive' is gone).

LEAD / SPLIT: Spring Creek Campground (not in the DB) - 21 primitive sites along Old Pump Station Rd on the Spring Creek embayment / Tennessee River bank, centre ~35.651,-88.017 (from the park map, not pinned on imagery). The engine lists every site with a max RV length of 22-124 ft and no tent-only designation, $19-22 a night, bookable at https://reserve.tnstateparks.com/mousetail-landing/campsites; the stored note's 'tent-only' is not supported by any current page. No water or electric; toilets only at the Sunset Point lot on the map. Worth a vetting pass (possible waterfront primitive entry).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - Main Campground is on the ridge; the river and embayment are ~0.5 km+ away.
